steps.name: Wounded 'Researcher'
steps.text: Sea Patrol. Here to interrogate me?

steps.name: Wounded 'Researcher'
steps.text: 'Interrogate.' Ha. I never thought I'd have anything to do with that word.

steps.name: Secunda
steps.text: You should have thought of that when you intruded on the lab.

steps.name: Wounded 'Researcher'
steps.text: What about before then? What makes you and I so different?

steps.name: Wounded 'Researcher'
steps.text: Why 'interrogate' me? What have I done to deserve being 'questioned'?

steps.name: Secunda
steps.text: At times like these, I feel like our methods are too gentle.

steps.name: Secunda
steps.text: According to our envoy from Iberia, they're more than happy to incorporate punishment into the process.

steps.name: Secunda
steps.text: So if you're finished talking nonsense, state your identity.

steps.name: Wounded 'Researcher'
steps.text: I'm a former road-side coral breeder.

steps.name: Secunda
steps.text: Motive?

steps.name: Wounded 'Researcher'
steps.text: You ever paid close attention to the coral by the road, Patroller?

steps.name: Wounded 'Researcher'
steps.text: We hoped every cluster on every street would take on a different form or color, even different capabilities.

steps.name: Wounded 'Researcher'
steps.text: Transport tubes pass through the cavity-filled cluster on the east side of the Sophontheatrum, and under the glimmering tubes, the polyps glimmer back. A patchwork of dots of light...

steps.name: Wounded 'Researcher'
steps.text: Like a nebula in miniature.

steps.name: Wounded 'Researcher'
steps.text: Then there's the ones around the port—

steps.name: Secunda
steps.text: As it happens, I have been paying close attention to some road-side coral recently. Specifically, the ones growing in your experimental field.

spans.text: been paying close attention to some road-side coral recently. Specifically, the ones growing in your experimental field.

steps.name: Secunda
steps.text: Where an innocent data scientist died.

steps.name: Secunda
steps.text: Her dreams, her obsession, her love for her seaweeds... were as beautiful as the coral you speak of.

steps.name: Secunda
steps.text: But you murdered her.

steps.name: Secunda
steps.text: You asked a good question earlier. What makes you and her so different?

steps.name: Secunda
steps.text: So why are you still alive? What did she do to deserve death?

steps.name: Wounded 'Researcher'
steps.text: She found...

steps.name: Secunda
steps.text: Found what? Speak up.

steps.name: Secunda
steps.text: Or are you implying I should be asking Cassia this question?

steps.name: Wounded 'Researcher'
steps.text: You...

steps.name: Secunda
steps.text: What is the Church planning against the Waterway Program?

steps.name: Secunda
steps.text: Will you be attacking the beacon, or the weapons?

steps.name: Secunda
steps.text: Speak.

steps.name: Wounded 'Researcher'
steps.text: *sigh* Church this, cultist that.

steps.name: Wounded 'Researcher'
steps.text: I'm still not used to being called names like that. You sure they're not just convenient excuses for you to arrest people?

steps.name: Wounded 'Researcher'
steps.text: This so-called 'Church' and its 'cultists.' What part of them is 'holy,' exactly?

steps.name: Wounded 'Researcher'
steps.text: I don't worship any kind of imaginary entity. I just agree with how Cassia sees things.

steps.name: Wounded 'Researcher'
steps.text: From the despair engulfing Ægir, she can see this nation's fragile nature.

steps.name: Wounded 'Researcher'
steps.text: People place too much importance on the value of things, but are unwilling to recognize how fickle these values really are. They've become worshipers at their altar.

steps.name: Wounded 'Researcher'
steps.text: But now, those values are crumbling away. Before Ægir falls completely into despair, someone must sound the alarm—

steps.name: Wounded 'Researcher'
steps.text: Perii! You're just trying to loosen my lips!

steps.name: Wounded 'Researcher'
steps.text: You won't get another word out of me. If you're feeling impatient, go ahead, scan my brainwaves. You won't get anything out of that either—

steps.name: Secunda
steps.text: Questioning you is the last respect I'll give you as a human being, scumbag!

steps.name: Secunda
steps.text: Maybe you believe yourself innocent, and your actions free of conspiracy. But you will tell me everything I want to know.

spans.text: Maybe you believe yourself innocent, and your actions free of conspiracy. But you
tell me everything I want to know.

steps.name: Secunda
steps.text: Now speak.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: Captain.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: It's almost time for us to leave, Skadi.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: I know it's urgent.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: The frontline is barely holding ground against the Seaborn. The loss of two entire fleets is really hitting us hard now.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: According to their most recent missive, Legions VIII and X failed to regroup into formation, and they are now mired in a bitter struggle.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: If the beacon cannot be deployed at the designated position within the nest, and the deadlock continues... it will mean the failure of the Waterway Program.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: Understood.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: The Legion fleets are about to launch an offensive across the entire front, at all costs. All to attract the Seaborn's attention. As for us—

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: Squeeze through the battlefield, infiltrate the nest, and deploy the beacon.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: Correct. How would you rate your current condition, Skadi?

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: I got some good sleep, at least. My first dreamless sleep since our last campaign.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: The situation in the city is getting more restive... Do you know where the Doctor has gone?

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: (Shakes head)

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: I know you want me to keep the peace and protect the Doctor, Captain... You want me to stay.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: To be honest, I am conflicted.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: Cleansing the sea of its dregs is our duty, but I am also responsible for your safety.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: Have there been any signs of Ishar'mla stirring since we returned to sea?

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: If it has, it's been real quiet.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: If it speaks up, I'll shut it up.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: Actually, I've got something to say to you, Captain.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: We've never been this cautious in our work before. We had our ways of handling this sort of thing.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: If the Church's god—the one the scum call 'Ishar'mla'—really is inside me, then if I ever go out of control, I want you to execute me on the spot. Simple as that.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: My heart's right here. I trust you won't miss.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: Skadi—

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: I'm not finished.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: If you or Shark start to fall under their influence in battle before I do, I won't hesitate either.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: What I was going to say is that, with war close at hand, I can imagine nothing more reassuring to hear.

spans.text: to say is that, with war close at hand, I can imagine nothing more reassuring to hear.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: Let's go.
Miss Laurentina.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: No need for that dreary honorific, little bird. We're not strangers, are we?

steps.name: Irene
steps.text: ...Laurentina.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Considering how long we've been in this city, I'm surprised this is the first time we've run into one another. This is sad.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: I've always wanted to take our brave little warrior out on a real hunt in the depths. Sadly, the nest we're headed to is too far and too deep. No way to bring you along.

steps.name: Irene
steps.text: It's alright. Even if I had the option, I'd stay in Milliarium regardless.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Oh?

steps.name: Irene
steps.text: There's been a lot happening in the city lately.

steps.name: Irene
steps.text: The first time I wore deep-water equipment and entered the ocean, I was immediately knocked about by the current. I hate to admit it, but I'd be dead weight out there.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: No need to talk like that. The first time is always rough.

steps.name: Irene
steps.text: Anyway, I can do a lot more in the city than in that nest.

steps.name: Irene
steps.text: And once you've completed your mission and Ægir's weapon systems start cleansing the area, I'll have to return to Saint Carmen and make an urgent report on why the sea surface has changed.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Ah, so you meant we were to be parted once more.

steps.name: Irene
steps.text: That's right.

steps.name: Irene
steps.text: I'd be offering you all farewell gifts, but I wasn't expecting this before we left for Milliarium, so I have nothing to give.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Don't worry about it. We'll meet again.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: While we won't be needing to drag you from the sea half-drowned this time, I have a feeling our next reunion will be unforgettable in its own right.

steps.name: Irene
steps.text: *cough*! ...Oh, look, Skadi and Gladiia are coming!

steps.name: Irene
steps.text: Take care of yourself, Laurentina.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Finished with your chat?

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: It's past time we left, Hunters.

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: Doctor.

options: Seems you got the evidence you wanted.

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: Yes. You've been of great assistance.

options: Not going to fill me in?

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: As previously mentioned, there are unusual data interactions between the beacon within the city and the ones deployed in the nests.

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: It seems the bulk of the work was handled by Lab C-22. Namely, the facility we just infiltrated.

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: While I do not fully understand the principles behind the beacon system or the Class IV weapons, the contents of these interactions can still be inferred.

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: The coordination between the beacons and the weapons has been altered.

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: As I surmised, the Waterway Program has been infiltrated at the highest level.

options: Did you doubt the program from the start?

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: Correct.

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: Even before it was conceived, I had my doubts about Ægir.

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: ...That decisive campaign.

options: You were meant to kill the Firstborn.
But you lost contact with your team.
Skadi was left to take the burden.

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: ...So you already know.

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: Skadi trusts you more than expected.

options: I put it together from what she said.
She's not sure what happened herself.

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: My dereliction was due to a moment of distraction.

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: In a cave, or rather, a cavity closest to Ishar'mla's core, I noticed something that should not be there.

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: Crude piles of meat, turbid mucus. At first, I assumed they were nodules of its body, but then I saw clearly the measuring scales and flow channels around them...

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: A corroded water flow meter.

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: One from Ægir. A design hundreds of years old, one that now exists only in museums.

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: Based on the degradation, it had sat within Ishar'mla's body for two centuries.

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: But I had been told that no other Ægir had ever managed to reach the Firstborn before us.

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: That is to say, before Ægir was even aware of it, its people had secretly come into contact with the Firstborn.

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: The undercurrents beneath tranquil Ægir are more turbulent than anyone could imagine.

options: I also found something odd while you were out.
As soon as the Hunters awoke, they left.

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: They are being used to break the deadlock at the front.

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: I can imagine the mission they have been assigned. Bypass the front lines, advance to the nest, and deploy the beacon.

options: First support, now the linchpin? It's too quick.
The advisor seemed more anxious than them.
He left the lab at the first opportunity.

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: Blandus.

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: Then I fear we, too, must act as quickly as possible.

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: If the coordination between the beacons and weapons has been tampered with, then there is only one place to go: the core of the Waterway Program. The beacon launcher.

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: As for you...

options: I'll go see the one who gave the order.
